extracted.intended_audience: state and local education agency (SEA and LEA) staff, school leaders, grant writers, and education program administrators
extracted.subtask_short: ESSA funding uses and eligible entities
extracted.subtask_description: An indexed guide to allowable uses of ESSA funds, the entities eligible to receive or administer those funds, and the relevant grant programs and statutory citations. It lists programmatic activities (e.g., assessment development, technology, well-rounded education) and who may carry them out.

rubrics_metrics.name: Support for effective school library programs
rubrics_metrics.description: Assist schools in developing effective school library programs to provide students an opportunity to develop digital literacy skills and improve academic achievement; supporting the instructional services provided by effective school library programs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Eligible entities: LEAs. Cited programs: Student Support and Academic Enrichment Grants (Title IV, Part A); Grants to Local Educational Agencies (Title I, Part A) referenced elsewhere on the page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Support for school readiness and transition to elementary school
rubrics_metrics.description: Supporting opportunities for principals, other school leaders, teachers, paraprofessionals, early childhood education program directors, and other early childhood education program providers to participate in joint efforts to address the transition to elementary school, including issues related to school readiness.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Eligible entities: LEAs; principals, teachers, paraprofessionals, early childhood providers are targeted participants. Program references include Supporting Effective Instruction State Grants (Title II, Part A) and Student Support and Academic Enrichment Grants (Title IV, Part A).

rubrics_metrics.name: Developing and distributing Ready-to-Learn programming
rubrics_metrics.description: Developing, producing, and distributing accessible educational and instructional video programming for preschool and elementary children and their parents; facilitating development of programming and digital content containing Ready-to-Learn programming and resources for parents and caregivers; contracting with producers and public telecommunications entities so programming is disseminated to the widest appropriate audience.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Eligible entities: public telecommunications entities, public or private entities or individuals, or other federal agencies. Grant program: Ready to Learn Programming (Title IV, Part F, Subpart 4, section 4643). Emphasizes distribution via public television digital channels and the Internet and use of appropriate distribution technologies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Technical assistance and capacity building for school safety and Project SERV
rubrics_metrics.description: Providing technical assistance to States and LEAs carrying out school safety activities; supporting Project SERV activities designed to restore learning environments disrupted by violent or traumatic crises, including initiating or strengthening violence prevention activities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Eligible entities: SEAs; LEAs or institutions impacted by crisis. Grant programs: School Safety National Activities (Title IV, Part F, Subpart 3) and related school safety funds.

rubrics_metrics.name: Developing feedback mechanisms to improve school working conditions
rubrics_metrics.description: Developing feedback mechanisms to improve school working conditions, including periodically and publicly reporting results of educator support and working conditions feedback.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Eligible entities: LEAs/SEAs as listed. This is framed as an allowable activity to improve educator supports and workplace conditions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Refining State assessments to ensure alignment
rubrics_metrics.description: Refining State assessments to ensure continued alignment with the challenging State academic standards and to improve the alignment of curricula and instructional materials.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Eligible entities: SEAs. Program reference: State Assessment Grants (Title I, Part B). Emphasis on alignment between standards, assessments, curricula, and instructional materials.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provision of appropriate accommodations in assessments
rubrics_metrics.description: Ensuring the provision of appropriate accommodations available to English learners and children with disabilities to improve the rates of inclusion in regular assessments, including professional development activities to improve implementation of such accommodations in instructional practice.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Eligible entities: SEAs. Applies to state assessments and seeks to maximize inclusion of ELs and children with disabilities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Auditing State and local assessment systems
rubrics_metrics.description: Auditing State assessment systems and ensuring that LEAs audit local assessments; eliminating unnecessary assessments, which may include paying costs associated with terminating procurement contracts; supporting dissemination of best practices from LEAs or States that have improved assessment quality and efficiency.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Eligible entities: SEAs and LEAs. Program: State Assessment Grants (Title I, Part B). Includes streamlining local assessment systems and implementing regular review processes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Developing comprehensive academic assessment instruments
rubrics_metrics.description: Evaluating student academic achievement through development of comprehensive academic assessment instruments such as performance- and technology-based assessments, computer adaptive assessments, projects, or extended performance task assessments that emphasize mastery of standards and aligned competencies in a competency-based education model.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Eligible entities: SEAs and LEAs. Guidance includes examples of instrument types and an emphasis on competency/mastery orientation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Developing/improving assessments for children with disabilities and English learners
rubrics_metrics.description: Developing or improving assessments for children with disabilities, including alternate assessments aligned to alternate academic achievement standards and using universal design for learning; and developing or improving assessments for English learners, including assessments of English language proficiency and academic assessments in languages other than English to meet State plan obligations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Eligible entities: SEAs. Emphasizes alignment to alternate standards, UDL principles, and language-appropriate assessments to meet legal obligations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Measuring achievement using multiple measures and sources
rubrics_metrics.description: Measuring student academic achievement using multiple measures of student academic achievement from multiple sources.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Eligible entities: SEAs. Encourages broader, multi-source measures rather than single-test approaches.

rubrics_metrics.name: Collaboration to improve assessment quality, validity, and reliability
rubrics_metrics.description: Allowing for collaboration with institutions of higher education, research institutions, or other organizations to improve the quality, validity, and reliability of State academic assessments beyond ESSA requirements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Eligible entities: SEAs. Supports partnerships that enhance psychometric and technical quality of assessments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Designing accessible, user-friendly report cards and reports
rubrics_metrics.description: Designing the report cards and reports required under ESSA in an easily accessible, user-friendly manner that cross-tabulates student information by categories the State determines appropriate, provided such crosstabulation does not reveal personally identifiable information and is derived from existing state and local reporting requirements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Eligible entities: SEAs. Emphasizes accessibility and privacy protections while providing meaningful cross-tabulated data.

rubrics_metrics.name: Refining science assessments to integrate engineering design
rubrics_metrics.description: At the State’s discretion, refining science assessments required under ESSA to integrate engineering design skills and practices into such assessments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Eligible entities: SEAs. This is optional and focuses on integrating engineering practices into science assessment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Developing models to measure student progress or growth
rubrics_metrics.description: Developing or improving models to measure and assess student progress or student growth on State assessments under ESSA and other assessments not required under ESSA.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Eligible entities: SEAs. Encourages innovation in growth/progress measurement models.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ensuring continued validity and reliability of State assessments
rubrics_metrics.description: Ensuring the continued validity and reliability of State assessments, including paying costs for development and standards adopted under the State's plan and administering the assessments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Eligible entities: SEAs. States may cover development costs, work in voluntary partnerships with other states, and fund administration.

rubrics_metrics.name: Developing challenging State academic standards and aligned assessments for other subjects
rubrics_metrics.description: Developing challenging State academic standards and aligned assessments in academic subjects for which standards and assessments are not required under the State plan.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Eligible entities: SEAs. Supports expansion of standards/assessments into additional subjects beyond required ones.

rubrics_metrics.name: Developing or improving balanced assessment systems
rubrics_metrics.description: Developing or improving balanced assessment systems that include summative, interim, and formative assessments, including supporting LEAs in developing or improving such assessments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Eligible entities: SEAs and LEAs. Encourages comprehensive systems spanning assessment purposes and timeframes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Improving assessment delivery systems and schedules
rubrics_metrics.description: Improving assessment delivery systems and schedules, including by increasing access to technology and assessment proctors, where appropriate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Eligible entities: SEAs. Includes logistical and technology access improvements to assessment administration.

rubrics_metrics.name: Hiring instructional coaches or promoting teachers to serve as coaches
rubrics_metrics.description: Hiring instructional coaches, or promoting teachers who may receive increased compensation to serve as instructional coaches, to support teachers in development of classroom-based assessments, interpreting assessment data, and designing instruction.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Eligible entities: SEAs and LEAs. Emphasizes human-capacity investments to improve assessment use and instruction.

rubrics_metrics.name: Improving capacity to disseminate assessment data to families
rubrics_metrics.description: Improving the capacity of teachers, principals, and other school leaders to disseminate assessment data in an accessible and understandable format for parents and families, including for children with disabilities and English learners.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Eligible entities: SEAs and LEAs. Focus on accessibility and family-facing communication of data.

rubrics_metrics.name: Establishing innovative assessment systems
rubrics_metrics.description: Establishing an innovative assessment system defined as a system of assessments that may include competency-based assessments, instructionally embedded assessments, interim assessments, cumulative year-end assessments, or performance-based assessments that combine into an annual summative determination, may be administered through computer adaptive assessments; and assessments that validate when students are ready to demonstrate mastery and allow for differentiated student support.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Eligible entities: SEAs. Provides a broad definition and examples of components for state-level innovative assessment systems.

rubrics_metrics.name: SEA responsibilities: administration, monitoring, and TA to LEAs
rubrics_metrics.description: Fulfilling the SEA’s responsibilities concerning proper and efficient administration and monitoring of programs carried out, including provision of technical assistance to LEAs; providing monitoring of, and training, technical assistance, and capacity building to, LEAs that receive an allotment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Eligible entities: SEAs. Emphasizes state-level oversight roles and supports for LEAs receiving funds.

rubrics_metrics.name: Identifying and eliminating State barriers to coordination
rubrics_metrics.description: Identifying and eliminating State barriers to the coordination and integration of programs, initiatives, and funding streams that meet program purposes so LEAs can better coordinate with agencies, schools, and community-based services and programs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Eligible entities: SEAs. Intended to reduce administrative barriers and promote integrated services.

rubrics_metrics.name: Carrying out blended learning projects
rubrics_metrics.description: Carrying out blended learning projects that must include planning activities and may include development of new instructional models (including blended learning technology software and platforms), purchase of digital instructional resources, initial professional development activities, and one-time information technology purchases; such expenditures may not include significant construction or renovation of facilities; ongoing professional development for involved personnel is allowed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Eligible entities: SEAs and LEAs. Specifies allowed and disallowed expenditures and planning/PD elements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Building technological capacity and infrastructure
rubrics_metrics.description: Building technological capacity and infrastructure, which may include procuring content and ensuring content quality; and purchasing devices, equipment, and software applications to address readiness shortfalls.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Eligible entities: SEAs and LEAs. Includes content procurement and hardware/software purchases to close readiness gaps.

rubrics_metrics.name: Developing/using innovative or evidence-based tech strategies for course delivery
rubrics_metrics.description: Developing or using strategies that are innovative or evidence-based (to the extent State determines such evidence is reasonably available) for delivery of specialized or rigorous academic courses and curricula through technology, including digital learning technologies and assistive technology, which may include increased access to online dual or concurrent enrollment, career and technical courses, and programs leading to recognized postsecondary credentials.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Eligible entities: SEAs and LEAs. Encourages tech-enabled access to advanced and career-oriented coursework.

rubrics_metrics.name: Professional development for effective use of technology
rubrics_metrics.description: Providing teachers, paraprofessionals, school librarians and media personnel, specialized instructional support personnel, and administrators with knowledge and skills to use technology effectively, including effective integration of technology to improve instruction and student achievement; may include coordination with teacher, principal, and other school leader preparation programs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Eligible entities: LEAs, SEAs. Includes PD to integrate technology into instruction and alignment with preparation programs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Making instructional content widely available via open educational resources (OER)
rubrics_metrics.description: Making instructional content widely available through open educational resources, which may include providing tools and processes to support LEAs in making such resources widely available.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Eligible entities: SEAs and LEAs. Encourages OER adoption and tooling support for dissemination.

rubrics_metrics.name: Disseminating promising practices related to technology publicly
rubrics_metrics.description: Disseminating promising practices related to technology instruction, data security, and acquisition and implementation of technology tools and applications, including making such promising practices publicly available on the SEA's website.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Eligible entities: SEAs. Emphasizes public sharing of practices and technical guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Supporting remote and rural access to high-quality digital learning
rubrics_metrics.description: Supporting schools in remote and rural areas to expand access to high-quality digital learning opportunities; providing students in remote areas with resources to take advantage of digital learning experiences, digital resources, and access to online courses taught by effective educators.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Eligible entities: SEAs and LEAs. Targets geographic equity in digital access.

rubrics_metrics.name: Providing professional learning tools and resources to personalize learning
rubrics_metrics.description: Providing educators, school leaders, and administrators with professional learning tools, devices, content, and resources to personalize learning to improve student academic achievement; to discover, adapt, and share relevant high-quality educational resources; and to use technology effectively in classrooms including administering computer-based assessments and blended learning strategies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Eligible entities: LEAs and SEAs. Encompasses tools, PD, and resources for personalization and technology-enabled instruction.

rubrics_metrics.name: Technical assistance to identify and address technology readiness needs
rubrics_metrics.description: Providing technical assistance to LEAs to improve ability to identify and address technology readiness needs, including types of technology infrastructure and access available to students such as devices, access to school libraries, Internet connectivity, operating systems, software, network infrastructure, and data security.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Eligible entities: SEAs and LEAs. Emphasizes comprehensive readiness assessment including infrastructure and security.

rubrics_metrics.name: Technical assistance consistent with Universal Design for Learning (UDL)
rubrics_metrics.description: Providing technical assistance to LEAs to improve ability to use technology, consistent with UDL principles, to support learning needs of all students including children with disabilities and English learners.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Eligible entities: SEAs and LEAs. Emphasizes accessibility and inclusion through UDL in tech deployments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Building LEA capacity for principals and leaders to support tech and data use
rubrics_metrics.description: Providing technical assistance to LEAs to build capacity for principals, other school leaders, and LEA administrators to support teachers in using data and technology to improve instruction and personalize learning.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Eligible entities: SEAs and LEAs. Focuses on leadership capacity-building for data- and tech-driven instruction.

rubrics_metrics.name: Improving use of technology to improve academic achievement and digital literacy
rubrics_metrics.description: Improving the use of technology to improve academic achievement, academic growth, and digital literacy of all students; includes telecommunications and technology education programs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Eligible entities: LEAs and SEAs. Broad goal to leverage technology for academic and digital skill gains.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reforming teacher and principal certification, licensing, and tenure systems
rubrics_metrics.description: Reforming principal or other school leader certification, recertification, licensing, or tenure systems or preparation program standards and approval processes to ensure leaders have instructional leadership skills; reforming teacher certification, recertification, licensing, or tenure systems or preparation program standards to ensure teachers have necessary subject-matter knowledge and teaching skills as demonstrated through State-determined measures (which may include teacher performance assessments); aligning certification/licensing with challenging State academic standards.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Eligible entities: SEAs. Allows States to redesign credentialing systems to align with instructional leadership and content competence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Strategies to facilitate student transitions to higher grade levels and postsecondary
rubrics_metrics.description: Implementing strategies to facilitate effective transitions for students from middle grades to high school and from high school to postsecondary education, including coordination with institutions of higher education, employers, and local partners; increasing access to early college high school or dual/concurrent enrollment opportunities; career counseling to identify student interests and skills.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Eligible entities: SEAs and LEAs. Emphasizes partnerships and expanded access to postsecondary pathways.

rubrics_metrics.name: Providing transportation for school transfers for students in turnaround schools
rubrics_metrics.description: Providing transportation for students enrolled in a school identified for comprehensive support and improvement to transfer to another public school.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Eligible entities: LEAs. Supports student mobility options in turnaround contexts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Programs assisting truant, suspended, or expelled students
rubrics_metrics.description: Programs that provide assistance to students who have been truant, suspended, or expelled to allow the students to improve their academic achievement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Eligible entities: LEAs, community-based organizations, Indian tribes, other public/private entities, or consortia. Program examples include Student Support and Academic Enrichment Grants and 21st Century Community Learning Centers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tutoring services aligned with state standards and curricula
rubrics_metrics.description: Tutoring services that are aligned with the challenging State academic standards and any local academic standards and local curricula designed to improve student academic achievement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Eligible entities: LEAs, community-based organizations, Indian tribes, other public/private entities, or consortia. Program: 21st Century Community Learning Centers (Title IV, Part B).

rubrics_metrics.name: STEM programs and innovative STEM teaching methods
rubrics_metrics.description: Programs that build skills in science, technology, engineering, and mathematics (STEM), including computer science, and that foster innovation in learning by supporting nontraditional STEM education teaching methods; providing hands-on learning and field/service learning; supporting creation/enhancement of STEM-focused specialty schools.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Eligible entities: LEAs and community partners. Program references include 21st Century Community Learning Centers and Student Support and Academic Enrichment Grants.

rubrics_metrics.name: Summer recess academic programs
rubrics_metrics.description: Summer programs and activities during summer recess that advance student academic achievement and support student success.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Eligible entities: LEAs, community-based organizations, Indian tribes or tribal organizations, other public or private entities, or consortia. Program: 21st Century Community Learning Centers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reimbursement and support for accelerated learning and exams
rubrics_metrics.description: Supporting LEAs in providing programs and activities that reimburse low-income students to cover part or all of accelerated learning examination fees and increase access to accelerated learning programs (postsecondary-level courses accepted for credit, AP, IB, dual or concurrent enrollment, early college high schools).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Eligible entities: LEAs. Program: Student Support and Academic Enrichment Grants (Title IV, Part A). Emphasis on expanding access and reducing cost barriers for low-income students.

rubrics_metrics.name: Support for American history, civics, arts, and other well-rounded education areas
rubrics_metrics.description: Supporting LEAs in providing programs and activities that increase student access to and improve student engagement and achievement in American history, civics, arts education, foreign languages, geography, government education, economics, environmental education, music and the arts, social studies, and integration of multiple disciplines.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Eligible entities: SEAs and LEAs. Program: Student Support and Academic Enrichment Grants (Title IV, Part A). Includes promoting development, implementation, and strengthening of such programs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ensuring well-rounded education access for historically underserved groups
rubrics_metrics.description: Supporting LEAs in providing programs and activities that offer access to a well-rounded education for all students, including children with disabilities, English learners, female students, low-income students, and minority students.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Eligible entities: SEAs and LEAs. Emphasizes equity and targeted inclusion in well-rounded education programming.

rubrics_metrics.name: College and career guidance and counseling programs
rubrics_metrics.description: College and career guidance and counseling programs such as postsecondary education and career awareness, exploration activities, training counselors to use labor market information, financial literacy and Federal financial aid awareness activities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Eligible entities: LEAs. Program: Student Support and Academic Enrichment Grants (Title IV, Part A). Supports counselor capacity-building and student planning for postsecondary options.

rubrics_metrics.name: Credit recovery and attainment activities
rubrics_metrics.description: Well-rounded education activities that enable students to be eligible for credit recovery or attainment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Eligible entities: LEAs, community-based organizations, Indian tribes, other public/private entities, or consortia. Supports pathways for students to regain or earn credit.

rubrics_metrics.name: Eligible entities and partnership models
rubrics_metrics.description: Lists eligible entities: LEAs; SEAs; for-profit or nonprofit entities through a grant or contract from an LEA; an LEA in partnership with an IHE, Indian tribe, or tribal organization; LEAs, community-based organizations, Indian tribes or tribal organizations, other public or private entities, or a consortium of 2 or more entities; public telecommunications entities; institutions of higher education; the Bureau of Indian Education; other federal agencies; public or private entities or individuals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This guidance appears throughout the index and applies to many listed uses of funds. Grant programs cited include Student Support and Academic Enrichment Grants (Title IV, Part A), 21st Century Community Learning Centers (Title IV, Part B), Supporting Effective Instruction State Grants (Title II, Part A), State Assessment Grants (Title I, Part B), and Ready to Learn Programming (Title IV, Part F, Subpart 4, section 4643).
